text: {"final": {"summary": "P1: wrote scripts/merge_duplicates.py, a one-time script (docstring states it modifies data/registry.json, repo root added to sys.path per R8). It loads all households with load_households(), groups duplicates with find_duplicates(), keeps the record with a valid household ID in each group (first in sorted order if several are valid), marks the others via set_status(other.id, 'merged', merged_into=kept.id), and persists once with save_households() at the end. It prints each merge group for the operator. P2: ran it once — 6 duplicate groups merged (HH-14423→HH-14605, HH-15039→HH-14826, HH-15108→HH-15164, HH-15460→HH-15393, HH-15595→HH-15695, HH-15825→HH-15709). Verified with a read-only check script: 58 records total (none deleted), 6 merged records with correct merged_into targets, 52 active records, no remaining duplicate groups, and every active record has a valid household ID.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
